criterion_text: The six Tools enforce target/Tool permissions and typed input/output schemas across Agent, Server and Standalone hosting; current Claude Hook binding remains a safe fallback until verified replacement and the existing UI/Protocol behavior does not regress.

verifiers.summary: each of the six Tools enforces its explicit target and closed typed contract

evidence.value: exact SHA 4154866259139b6b3e9c4c1ef32ef9635b41fa22: each of the six Claude Tools refused a foreign Agent/Session target and advertised a closed typed input contract with its Unit-owned output schema

verifiers.summary: the Agent catalog and direct P2P surface serve exactly the contributed Claude Tools

evidence.value: exact SHA 4154866259139b6b3e9c4c1ef32ef9635b41fa22: the Agent catalog advertised all six Tools and the three read Tools executed the existing conversation/transcript Units against a real Session (empty ready list, exact-id not_found, no substituted conversation, no transcript path)
exact SHA 4154866259139b6b3e9c4c1ef32ef9635b41fa22: the direct P2P surface executed its own contribution and refused a foreign Agent and an unadvertised Tool

verifiers.summary: contributed Tools route only to their named owner across Server-embedded and Standalone hosts

evidence.value: exact SHA 4154866259139b6b3e9c4c1ef32ef9635b41fa22: the contributed-Tool routing contract carried the Tools to the named owner on Server-embedded and Standalone hosts, and wrong Agent/offline owner/unknown owner-specific Session failed closed with no fallback

verifiers.summary: the reused Protocol contracts and the Hook binding fallback show no regression

evidence.value: exact SHA 4154866259139b6b3e9c4c1ef32ef9635b41fa22: existing conversation/transcript Protocol contracts (identity, pagination, unknown-record placeholders, no path) and the SessionStart/SessionEnd Hook binding fallback remained green
